title: balancingGroupListEntry
description: One balancing group entry including its cluster assignment, validity period and responsible market partner.

internalAccount.description: Internal identifier of the balancing group.

clusterId.description: Unique identifier (name or ID) of the cluster assigned to the balancing group.

from.description: UTC timestamp marking the beginning of the balancing group's validity period.

to.description: UTC timestamp marking the end of the balancing group's validity period.
